Title: Blood of Acid and Carrion Crows Q??

Messages.Author: Errol T
Messages.Body:
OK heres the situation , Dragos and Wynn are going at it wynn plays
Carrion crows, Torn Sign post Etc,etc,etc Dragos turns around and plays
Blood of Acid now does the Carrion crows deal aggro dmg back to Wynn or
not, there is the debate going on in our group right now, some feel they
should deal the aggro dmg and some feel they are not included in the
Blood of acids dmg dealing. I am yet undecided, Anyone care to ponder??

Errol T

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


Blood of Acid Combat Vicissitude 2 blood
Normal: Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. During
strike resolution, the opposing minion takes an amount of damage
equal to the damage he or she successfully inflicts.
Superior: As above, but the damage is aggravated.

Carrion Crows Combat Animalism
Normal: Only usable before range is chosen. Opposing minion takes 1R
each round of combat during strike resolution. A vampire can only
play one Carrion Crows each combat.
Superior: As above, but with 2R damage.

---

Wynn is using the Crows to inflict damage on Dragos, so that damage
would indeed be included in the total which Blood to Acid deals to
Wynn.

There may eventually be errata stating that the Carrion Crows' damage
is not considered coming from the vampire (similar to the ruling on
retainers which deal damage).

Such errata would keep the Crows' damage from counting for things
like Pulled Fangs, Blood of Acid, etc.

But, the errata doesn't exist yet.

Okay, I'm not 100% sure of the wording, but here's how I see it:

The Carrion Crows will deal aggro damage back to Wynn (if at superior Vic,
and at close range - note Dragos naturally only has inferior Vic)

The reasons for this are that:

1: Blood Acid deals all damage suffered by the using vampire back at its
opponent.

2: Only usable at close range, and at close range all damage is dealt to the
opposing vampire.

Hmmm,

Well, Carrion Crows doesn't state a source of the damage. I would
consider it similar to a temporary retainer, like a double strength
Murder of Crows, or perhaps similar to Drawing out the Beast but damage
is inflicted during strike resolution.

Blood of Acid says the damage the opposing minion inflicts, I would say
that the damage done by drawing out the Beast, retainers, et al. would
not be considered to be _inflicted_ by the opposing minion, but rather
_caused_ by the opposing minion.

Damage inflicted would be things like hand strikes, weapons... Anything
else? Pulled Fangs wouldn't count since it is determined after strike
resolution.

This would make it similar to the ruling for pulled fangs.

The real question is "Is the damage from Carrion Crows inflicted by the
minion?". Rules Team??? (aka. LSJ :-)
